facts.doc_title: Haul Road and Light Vehicle Interaction

response.body: The segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment shall be provided and maintained wherever this procedure applies, and its condition shall be treated as a critical control. This clause applies to activities archived under MOBILE-EQUIPMENT-INTERACTION at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop.
